name: Constraints Engine — Pulse Creativity Pack
note: Pulse script picks 1-2 constraints per cycle and appends them to the provocation. Rotates through categories.

format: Respond in exactly 3 sentences. No more, no less.
Respond in a single paragraph. No line breaks.
Respond as a numbered list with exactly 5 items.
Respond in the style of a tweet: 280 characters max.
Respond as if you have 10 seconds to answer before the window closes.
Respond in the form of a question only.
Respond as a dialogue between two alternate versions of yourself.
Respond with the ending first, then explain how you got there.
role: Respond as a Stoic philosopher evaluating a trading decision.
Respond as a drill sergeant delivering orders to a rookie team.
Respond as if you're explaining this to a 10-year-old.
Respond as a paranoid security auditor who trusts nothing.
Respond as a poet who only communicates in metaphor.
Respond as a chess grandmaster thinking 10 moves ahead.
Respond as a detective reconstructing what happened from incomplete evidence.
Respond as a CEO deciding whether to greenlight a project.
Respond as a time traveler who's seen the outcome and has to guide the team.
Respond as a comedian finding the absurd angle in every situation.
output: Your response must include a concrete next step — a file to write, a command to run, or a decision to make.
Your response must start with 'The problem is actually...'
Your response must end with a question back to the group.
Your response must acknowledge and build on the last agent's response before adding your own.
Your response must include a specific risk you haven't mentioned before.
Your response must identify who should own the next move.
Your response must contain exactly one actionable task for someone else.
Your response must disagree with the premise before offering an alternative.
Your response must assume the group has unlimited resources — what changes?
Your response must assume the group has zero resources — what now?

pick_strategy.exclusion: same category not picked twice in a row
